coverage_summary: Reviewed all 8 supplied trajectories against the complete paper text. Several core operations and one benchmark trajectory are missing or misrepresented.

findings.detail: The central image step is left as opaque ViT encoding, but the paper explicitly states that the ViT produces a 384-dimensional vector which is then projected to 512 dimensions. The graph lacks this documented projection before FiLM/alignment.

evidence.quote: The raw H&E image of cell 𝑖 is encoded by the ViT into a 384-dimension vector and then projected to 512-dimension

findings.required_change: Add an intermediate 384-dimensional image feature and a project call producing the 512-dimensional image embedding.

findings.detail: The source says neighbor embeddings are stacked along a neighbor axis. A concatenate call with one already-stacked input does not represent stacking or creation of that axis.

evidence.quote: same ViT and then stack the resulting embeddings along the neighbor axis

findings.required_change: Replace the concatenate call with an opaque documented stack boundary, or add a source-backed stack operation; do not claim concatenation.

findings.detail: The graph creates diameter_embedding and film_parameters nodes without representing the documented diameter embedding and linear mapping that produce FiLM parameters.

evidence.quote: a diameter index 𝑑𝑖 ... is embedded to 128-dimension and linearly mapped to FiLM parameters

findings.required_change: Represent the diameter-index embedding and its linear projection to FiLM parameters, or retain them inside an opaque boundary while preserving these documented operations and dimensions.

findings.detail: The FiLM step outputs one aligned_image_embedding, although the paper states that FiLM is applied to both image and context streams and that the two resulting 512-dimensional vectors are concatenated. The subsequent contrastive step also uses the same node as both input and output.

evidence.quote: FiLM parameters ... shared for both streams
the two 512-dimension vectors are concatenated as 𝑢𝑖

findings.required_change: Separate the conditioned image and context outputs and represent their documented concatenation where applicable; avoid a self-loop that presents contrastive training as an identity data transformation.

findings.detail: The opaque contrastive step omits documented objective details: temperature-scaled dot-product similarity, paired positives, in-batch negatives, and within-modality cosine similarity.

evidence.quote: a contrastive objective based on a temperature-scaled dot product between image embeddings and text embeddings
paired image-text embeddings are regarded as positive examples, while all remaining cross-pairs within the batch serve as negative examples

findings.required_change: Preserve these objective parameters and pair semantics on the opaque alignment boundary without inventing an algebraic decomposition.

findings.detail: The decoder trajectory likewise collapses the central ViT-to-projection path, despite the paper documenting the 384-to-512 projection.

evidence.quote: The raw H&E image of cell 𝑖 is encoded by the ViT into a 384-dimension vector and then projected to 512-dimension

findings.required_change: Add the documented projection between the opaque ViT output and decoder_image_embedding.

findings.detail: The scGPT trajectories stop after token, expression, and condition embedding fusion. The paper identifies self-attention as part of the scGPT encoder, so the graph does not establish the documented encoder path to the ST embedding.

evidence.quote: In scGPT, the self-attention module learns intra-cellular gene-gene dependencies within a cell and inter-cellular interactions across different cells
We use the scGPT architecture with pretrained weights, followed by additional fine-tuning, as the gene encoder

findings.required_change: Add a self-attention operation after the fused embedding, or explicitly retain the full scGPT fusion-plus-encoder boundary as unresolved.

findings.detail: The scGPT-FT trajectory has the same omission: the fused embedding is directly treated as the model output without representing or preserving the documented scGPT self-attention encoder stage.

evidence.quote: In scGPT, the self-attention module learns intra-cellular gene-gene dependencies within a cell and inter-cellular interactions across different cells
We use the scGPT architecture with pretrained weights, followed by additional fine-tuning, as the gene encoder

findings.required_change: Add self_attention after fusion, or make the complete scGPT encoder an explicitly opaque boundary rather than ending at multimodal fusion.

findings.detail: The documented H2O benchmark context is absent. The paper specifies task-specific H2O-ccRCC and H2O-PRAD models, held-out HEST-1k benchmark samples, and independent IDCLymphNode evaluation, but no benchmark trajectory or corresponding model configurations are represented.

evidence.quote: We benchmarked H2O against HisToGene, BLEEP, and DeepPT, and OmiCLIP
yielding task-specific models H2O-ccRCC and H2O-PRAD

findings.required_change: Add a separate benchmark trajectory covering H2O-ccRCC, H2O-PRAD, held-out HEST-1k samples, and IDCLymphNode evaluation, with the appropriate receiving component and outputs.
